title: 2020 年 12 月英语六级真题（第 3 套）

analysis.topic: 北京大兴国际机场简介
analysis.reference: Beijing Daxing International Airport is located 46 kilometers south of Tian'anmen Square and was put into operation on September 30, 2019. Construction of the mega project started in 2014, with more than 40,000 workers on the construction site during peak periods. The terminal building features a compact design, which allows the maximum number of aircraft to park directly at positions closest to the center of the terminal, thus offering great convenience to passengers. The terminal has a total of 82 boarding gates, but after passing through security checks, passengers can reach any gate in less than 8 minutes. The design of the airport can ensure 300 takeoffs and landings per hour. The airport's annual passenger throughput is expected to reach 100 million by 2040, making it potentially the busiest airport in the world.

sentences.cn: 北京大兴国际机场位于天安门广场以南46公里处，于2019年9月30日投入使用。
sentences.en: Beijing Daxing International Airport is located 46 kilometers south of Tian'anmen Square and was put into operation on September 30, 2019.
sentences.structure: 并列谓语结构，is located... and was put into...，两个动作用 and 连接，时态分别为一般现在时和一般过去时
keys: 北京大兴国际机场 Beijing Daxing International Airport
投入使用 be put into operation/service

sentences.cn: 该巨型工程于2014年开工建设，高峰时工地上有4万多工人。
sentences.en: Construction of the mega project started in 2014, with more than 40,000 workers on the construction site during peak periods.
sentences.structure: with 复合结构作伴随状语，主句为简单过去时，with 短语补充说明施工高峰情况

sentences.cn: 航站楼设计紧凑，可以允许最大数量的飞机直接停靠在最靠近航站楼中心的位置，这给乘客提供了极大的方便。
sentences.en: The terminal building features a compact design, which allows the maximum number of aircraft to park directly at positions closest to the center of the terminal, thus offering great convenience to passengers.
sentences.structure: 非限制性定语从句 which allows... 修饰前面整个主句，末尾用现在分词短语 thus offering... 表结果

sentences.cn: 航站楼共有82个登机口，但乘客通过安检后，只需不到8分钟就能抵达任何一个登机口。
sentences.en: The terminal has a total of 82 boarding gates, but after passing through security checks, passengers can reach any gate in less than 8 minutes.
sentences.structure: 转折并列句，but 连接两个分句；after doing 作时间状语前置，强调安检之后的时间效率
keys: 通过安检 pass through security checks
不到8分钟 in less than 8 minutes

sentences.cn: 机场的设计可确保每小时300架次起降。
sentences.en: The design of the airport can ensure 300 takeoffs and landings per hour.
sentences.structure: 简单句，主语为 the design，谓语为 can ensure，宾语为数量短语
keys: 每小时300架次 300 takeoffs and landings per hour

sentences.cn: 机场年客运量2040年将达到1亿人次，有望成为世界上最繁忙的机场。
sentences.en: The airport's annual passenger throughput is expected to reach 100 million by 2040, making it potentially the busiest airport in the world.
sentences.structure: 现在分词短语 making it... 作结果状语；be expected to do 表达'有望'；by 2040 表示截止时间
keys: 年客运量 annual passenger throughput

keys.en: be put into operation / be put into service

pitfalls: aircraft 单复数同形，不可写成 aircrafts
'投入使用'易误译为 put into use，更地道说法为 put into operation/service
'1亿人次'中'人次'不可遗漏，应译为 100 million passenger trips，不能只写 100 million
'安检'应译为 security check，不可误写为 safe check 或 safety check
'每小时300架次起降'中'架次'为量词，需用 takeoffs and landings 体现，不宜用 flights 笼统替代

upgrades.plain: The airport was used on September 30, 2019
upgrades.better: The airport was put into operation on September 30, 2019
upgrades.note: put into operation 是基建投运的固定搭配，比 was used 更正式专业

upgrades.plain: there were more than 40,000 workers on the site
upgrades.better: with more than 40,000 workers on the construction site during peak periods
upgrades.note: with 复合结构作伴随状语，句式更紧凑，信息层次更清晰

upgrades.better: The terminal features a compact design
upgrades.note: feature 作动词表示'以……为特色'，更地道且避免被动语态的生硬

upgrades.plain: The passenger number will be 100 million
upgrades.better: The annual passenger throughput is expected to reach 100 million
upgrades.note: throughput 为航空客运领域专业术语，be expected to 比 will 更准确表达预期

upgrades.plain: and it may become the busiest airport
upgrades.better: making it potentially the busiest airport in the world
upgrades.note: 现在分词短语作结果状语，句式更高级；potentially 比 may 更书面
